features.name: area_sqm_unit_interval
features.description: Living area mapped to a bounded 0-1 coordinate using training-fold observed bounds.
features.expected_model_benefit: Keeps area comparable with other coordinates so neighbor search is not dominated by raw square-meter scale.

features.name: rooms_unit_interval
features.description: Room count mapped to a bounded 0-1 coordinate across the observed one-to-five room span.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates comparable room-count geometry for distance-based neighborhood matching.

features.name: floor_unit_interval
features.description: Floor value mapped to a bounded 0-1 coordinate covering basement through upper floors.
features.expected_model_benefit: Stabilizes floor-related distance contributions and helps neighbors align on vertical position.

features.name: scrape_time_unit_interval
features.description: Scrape timestamp mapped to a bounded 0-1 coordinate using training-fold observed bounds.
features.expected_model_benefit: Keeps temporally nearby rows closer without letting the timestamp scale overwhelm other distances.

features.name: title_unit_interval
features.description: Title numeric field mapped to a bounded 0-1 coordinate using the training-fold observed span.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a bounded coordinate for title magnitude while preventing this field from dominating distance calculations.

features.name: sqm_per_room_unit_interval
features.description: Area per room compressed into a bounded 0-1 spaciousness coordinate.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures layout density so rows with similar space-per-room patterns become closer.

features.name: distance_to_fold_centroid_core
features.description: Unsupervised Euclidean distance from the fold centroid over area, rooms, floor, and scrape time, with each coordinate divided by its fold dispersion.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a compact typicality axis that helps KNN separate central rows from geometric outliers.

features.name: distance_to_compact_layout_prototype
features.description: Distance to a generic compact two-room layout prototype using area, rooms, and floor on fold-scaled coordinates.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a generic prototype-distance axis that improves local geometry around compact dwellings.

features.name: compact_layout_cluster_flag
features.description: Indicator for compact one-or-two-room layouts with area at or below 60 square meters.
features.expected_model_benefit: Forms a crisp local neighborhood for compact layouts that may otherwise be blurred by continuous distances.

features.name: spacious_elevated_layout_cluster_flag
features.description: Indicator for roomy elevated layouts with at least three rooms, at least 85 square meters, and floor 15 or higher.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates an explicit neighborhood marker for large upper-floor dwellings without allowing any single raw scale to dominate.

features.name: title_presentation_semantic_score
features.description: Numeric assessor score from 0 to 1 using decoded title text or title-code metadata from the training fold; higher values indicate stronger presentation cues such as renovated, furnished, terrace, parking, panoramic, or central wording.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a bounded semantic similarity coordinate so listings with similar presentation wording become closer even when physical fields differ.

features.name: location_amenity_semantic_score
features.description: Numeric assessor score from 0 to 1 using decoded location text or location-code metadata from the training fold; higher values indicate stronger access, amenity, and centrality signals.
features.expected_model_benefit: Improves neighborhoods by grouping rows with semantically similar areas while using no outcome information.
